lead.headline: Rice didn't practise and is priced out — Golden and Love join the Packers report
lead.deck: Jacobs is back at practice and expected to play; that coin flip still waits on Friday.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Rashee Rice did not practise on Wednesday and ESPN has cut him to 0.0, so this morning's 'Rice into the flex' plan is withdrawn. Matthew Golden was limited with a shoulder and his quarterback, Jordan Love, with a back — both in a walk-through estimate (Packers.com, NBC/PFT 21 Oct); Xavier Worthy, who plays at 18:20, is Golden's fallback. The good news is Josh Jacobs: back at practice and expected to play (Field Level Media 21 Oct). He stays behind Gordon only because Green Bay's inactives come after Miami kick off; a clean Friday report puts him in. The lineup projects 122.7 to Furia Regia's 113.0, 55% on ESPN.
